Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Uterine Rupture.

Based on the ultrasound showing disruption of the uterine wall adjacent to a previous C-section scar, accompanied by hemoperitoneum and your history of pain and bleeding, I suspect you have a uterine rupture. This is a life-threatening emergency; please ensure you are ready for immediate transfer to the operating room for a Cesarean section.
